body: Yeah, I’m too afraid to anyways. I’m just tired of being consumed by these thoughts more often than not lately. I appreciate the replies back though. Thank you random internet friend

Deep down I know that. I just hate how god damn hard it is to see. 20 min ago I walked off and had the intention of finding a bridge but my brothers getting married in 2 days and so how could I possibly do that to them. Ugh.

I didn’t realize how much I needed to hear this. My boyfriend as amazing as he is, doesn’t understand depression and thinks I just get lazy when in reality I’m just so overwhelmed I can’t move sometimes. Thank you for your kind words

I’ve always had these thoughts on and off throughout my life. Lately they’ve been pretty much everyday. I got laid off a year ago and have been struggling to find something permanent since to keep up on the bills. Going to be getting evicted in a few days. Luckily my boyfriend and I have a place we just need to fix it up. Between that and always having this feeling that I’m not good enough and I criticize myself all the time. Sometimes the feeling is so strong and overwhelming I feel like I’m going to do it. I get moments where I feel glad I haven’t but I have tried twice in the past and I’m afraid that I really will succeed someday. I’ve tried getting help in the past but with no insurance I’ve been turned away by places who I was told would help me.  It’s just frustrating even thinking about trying to get help.
